annotations.title: Create or replace a wiki page

description: Create a page, or REPLACE the full content of an existing page, in your Frosh wiki. Show the user the title and content and get their explicit approval first, then call with confirm: true. Not idempotent: each call makes a new revision. If a call fails or times out, check with wiki_page_read and confirm with the user before retrying. Requires your Frosh API key (Authorization: Bearer frsh_...); only reaches the wiki that owns the key.

confirm.description: Must be true, and only after the user approved this exact edit.

name: wiki_page_write
title: Create or replace a wiki page
